title: Per-SU, per-fiscal-year extraction mapping
description:
collectors/<su-slug>/mappings/fyNNNN.yaml. Captures where in a specific budget document each schema field is stated, so next year's extraction is faster and so this SU's quirks stop living only in one person's head. Extraction from PDFs is assisted, not automated: the tool pre-fills what the mapping tells it to and a human confirms.

The rule this schema exists to enforce: every mapping MUST account for salaries, health insurance and FTEs -- either saying where the document states them, or explicitly recording that it does not. There is no way to leave them unmentioned. That is what makes a null in the warehouse mean 'the district did not publish it' rather than 'we did not look', and it is why the personnel block is a first-class extraction target rather than a nice-to-have: merger savings claims are overwhelmingly staffing claims.

artifact.description: Filename of the intake artifact this mapping reads, relative to intake/<su>/fy<year>/.

document_notes.description: How this document is laid out and anything peculiar about reading it. Written for a person who has never opened it before.

fields.description: Keyed by dotted budget-schema path, e.g. `expenditures.instruction`.

personnel_declaration.description: Mandatory statement about the object-class cut. Every key must be present: this block cannot be partially filled in, because a missing key would be exactly the ambiguity the whole rule exists to eliminate.

declaration.description: `stated` means the document publishes this and `location` says where. `not_published` means a human read the document and it is not there. There is no third option and no default -- 'we did not check' is not representable.

location.description: Page and line-item label, e.g. 'p. 17, "Salaries & Wages"'. Required when status is stated.

source.description: Where in the document this figure is stated: page and line-item label. Null with a populated `composed_of` means it is a sum of several lines.

composed_of.description: Line items summed into this rollup, each as printed. Recorded so a rollup can be re-derived and checked, since a coarse category assembled from a dozen lines is otherwise unauditable.

not_published.description: True when the document does not state this figure. The extractor emits a not_published entry for it rather than a bare null.
